correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction gives bounded forward solutions with \(S+I\) uniformly positive. The exact derivative identity for \(V=I+(R_x/\varepsilon)X\) is algebraically verified, its zero set reduces invariantly to \(I=X=0\), and the remaining plant subsystem is Hurwitz. Critical Lyapunov stability is separately justified by uniform infected-state control and variation of constants. For \(R_0>1\), the infected block has negative determinant and a positive eigenvalue.
